key_idea: Interpret the same digit string in bases 8, 10 and 16 with Horner's rule, printing 0 for octal if any digit is 8 or 9.
sketch: Read the token as a string so leading zeros are preserved and harmless. Accumulate o = o*8+d, v = v*10+d, h = h*16+d over the digits and flag the octal value invalid if a digit exceeds 7. With at most 7 digits the hex value is below 2^28, so 32-bit suffices; O(length) per case.
